{{Top|leg}}
An '''Implanted cyberjack''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]].<ref name="LORDS">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

A cyberjack typically took the form of a prosthetic, often a finger or other artificial appendage, and allowed the the user to directly interface with a computer system via a [[Scomp link/Legends|universal serial socket]]. Through the cyberjack the user could interface with [[droid]]s and computers, disable security devices, slice into computer systems, and control other cybernetics.<ref name="LORDS" />
